iQPU / UQConnect

Universal Quantum

iQPU / UQConnect

Universal Quantum · trapped ions · DEMONSTRATED (two-module machine) (2023-2026) · 64 physical qubits · access: lab; DLR contract milestones due end-2026
architecture: יונים לכודים — QCCD (הובלה בין אזורים) · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: hyperfine qubit
gate mechanism: microwave fields coupled through a static magnetic-field gradient, no per-qubit lasers
connectivity: QCCD within a module; UQConnect transfers ions between separate trap modules at 2,424 transfers per second with qubit-loss infidelity below 7e-8
control: chip-integrated microwave; UQLogic and UQConnect delivered as commercial ASICs
control placement: on-chip microwave
readout: fluorescence
flags: conflicting qubit counts, no published error rates
